paragraphs.text:
You see frozen creatures, like the stump-like things in the 
mosaics, but these former citizens are frozen solid. Make a 
Sanity roll and lose 0/1D6 Sanity points. You keep walking, 
and find you’ve been led back to the underground intersection. 
Return to 555.
(555, 558, 559, 561)
